name: 5 Layer Dip On A Chip
instructions: Preheat oven to the broiler setting
Place each chip , not overlapping , in an oven proof dish
Working with one chip at a time , spread one teaspoon of guacamole over each chip
Carefully dollop 1 / 2 tsp of chili on the guacamole , then sprinkle a little cheese on top of the chili
Place the dish in the oven , and remove after 3 minutes
Spoon 1 / 2 teaspoon of sour cream on top of each chip , then sprinkle a little bit of green onion on top of each for presentation
